en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Students will be introduced to the principles of proper nutrition, with the negative effects on health in case of improper lifestyle management. The goal is to teach students how to prevent civilization diseases through proper nutrition.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Human nutrition (allowance 4/0) a.The current state of human nutrition in the worldb.World Nutrition Organization (WHO)c.Trends in human nutrition2.Human nutrition physiology (allowance 2/2)3.Basic nutrients in human nutrition (allowance 8/10) a.The importance of proteins, fats and carbohydratesb.The importance of fiberc.Vitamins in human nutritiond.Mineral substances in human nutrition4.Biologically active substances (allowance 4/4) a.Antioxidants, probiotics, prebioticsb.Natural harmful substances in foodc.Substances arising during the treatment and processing of foodd.Additives - classification, use, possible risks5.Principles of proper nutrition (allowance 2/6) a.Energy value of foodb.Triple ratio of nutrientsc.Composition of the menu6.Nutrition of individual groups (allowance 4/2) a.Nutrition of pregnant and lactating womenb.Nutrition of childrenc.Sports nutrition7.Alimentary diseases (allowance 3/2) a.Diseases caused by improper nutritionb.Food in-toleration, allergyc.Alcoholism, the consequences of an incorrect lifestyle8.Nutrition in various diseases (allowance 2/2)
